name: civic-connect
description: Smart Civic Issue Reporting and Resolution System — an SDG 11 project. React + Express + PostgreSQL.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:openapi && npm test
